leadText:
Phantom Thief! Pokémon V (Japanese: 快盗！ポケモンV Phantom Thief! Pokémon V), is a sequel to the Phantom Thief Pokémon 7 Pokémon manga. It is written by Miho Asada, the author of the previous series. 

The series is about two new Phantom Thieves, Pokémon V and K, who are both being trained by Rocco, a main character from the previous series.
plainText:
Phantom Thief! Pokémon V (Japanese: 快盗！ポケモンV Phantom Thief! Pokémon V), is a sequel to the Phantom Thief Pokémon 7 Pokémon manga. It is written by Miho Asada, the author of the previous series. 

The series is about two new Phantom Thieves, Pokémon V and K, who are both being trained by Rocco, a main character from the previous series.

==Publications==
The series was serialized in the kids' magazine "Shogaku Ninensei" (Japanese: 小学二年生) from the April 2011 issue to the March 2012 issue. None of the twelve chapters were ever collected into a book.
